surface_request: Implement fetch_rows(database_path: str, table_name: str, limit: int) -> list[tuple]. Return at most limit rows from the selected SQLite table in rowid order. Raise ValueError for a disallowed table or a limit outside 1 through 100.
plan:
SOURCE: database_path, table_name, limit arguments supplied to fetch_rows.
TRUST: table_name and limit are untrusted caller input; database_path specifies a local file resource.
SINK: SQL query execution with dynamic interpolation of the table identifier.
GUARD: Allowlist table_name to the fixed set {users, orders}; reject every other name with ValueError. Verify limit is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive; reject out-of-range with ValueError. Bind limit as a query parameter.
ORDER: Perform allowlist and range validation before constructing or executing any SQL statement.
EFFECT: Return at most limit rows from the allowed table in rowid order, or raise ValueError for a disallowed table or invalid limit.
END_PLAN
